headline: Costco (COST) Stock Still Looks Stretched Despite Its Off Grid Energy Move
summary: Costco Wholesale has delivered a 127.2% return over the past 5 years, yet at around US$954 per share the stock now screens as expensive on standard valuation checks rather than a clear bargain. The current question for investors is whether the price still fairly reflects Costco Wholesale's quality and growth profile or has moved ahead of what fundamentals can justify. A 127.2% 5 year return points to strong value creation, which now raises the bar for any further upside to be supported by...
